{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.04

|descr= Returns if the marker is drawn with shadow enabled.

|pr= [[setMarkerType]] will reset the shadow value to the one defined in marker type.

|gr1= Markers

|s1= [[markerShadow]] marker

|p1= marker: [[String]] - the marker

|r1= [[Boolean]]: [[true]] if marker is enabled, [[false]] if not

|x1= <sqf>private _shadowEnabled = markerShadow _myMarker;</sqf>
